verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm offering legal advisory services and free document-generation questionnaires, not a developer platform, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. Its 'interactive questionnaire' tools are form-driven document automation, not an API reference. Probes also found no OpenAPI or swagger endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
